# Camp Resource: Chicken Coop

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 25, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_eb45004e47174640a27bb9cf07da4f5a~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

Set up this Chicken Coop and generate some fertilizer for your farm!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- AVAILABLE FOR GOLD BULLION PER CHARACTER. -

-C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Chicken Coop__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a49569ffaa4d419b89760fb9e484cbf3~mv2.png)

**Produces**

Fertilizer

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Caged Rabbit, Chicken Coop, and Rad-Pheasant Coop.

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 Fertilizer

**Obtainable via**

Season 1 - The Legendary Run - Rank 78

Gold Bullion - Samuel - Cautious - 750 Bullion

Gold Bullion - Minerva - List 3

Atom Shop - __Chicken Coop__ - 500 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

1 minute and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

9 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hi, I'm Kat or Duchess

I'm an Australian data miner who writes farming, event, and food buff guides for Fallout 76.

I believe that all knowledge and information should be free, which is why my guides will never be locked behind a paywall. However, running a website and photo and video editing software does not come cheaply.

So, if you find my guides helpful, please consider buying me a ko-fi (coffee) using the link below.

All monies go towards the tools for writing my guides and maybe for an actual cup of coffee or 3 ;)

Alternatively, share my guides with your fellow vault dwellers and help them to survive the wasteland.
